role: The catalogue of reusable open-source IP. One directory per category, one directory per IP inside it, and each IP is described by a manifest that points AT the upstream source rather than vendoring it.

invariants.why: The catalogue is enumerated by directory. An IP directory with no manifest is offered to the matcher and then contributes nothing to it, so the IP looks catalogued and is unusable.

invariants.statement: Every manifest.yaml declares ip_name, license and canonical_url.
invariants.why: This catalogue causes third-party code to be pulled into a user's design. Without a licence the user cannot know what they may ship, and without a canonical_url nobody can check what was pulled or re-pull the same thing later. Both are needed before the IP is usable, not after.

invariants.statement: No RTL source file may live in this package.
invariants.why: A manifest names an upstream commit; a vendored copy next to it silently becomes the thing that is actually built, and it drifts from the commit the manifest claims. Keeping the catalogue source-free means canonical_url is the only answer to 'what code is this'.

counterexample.proves: SystemVerilog at any depth is caught
